crossRefs.note: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”
Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One…
In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for…
You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax…
But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the…
Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”
The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?
Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
